description: Vector part done 2026-09-30 (the product decision moved to T-033). Upstash-Vector-compatible REST served by each container app's own Worker at {app}/_vector/{NAME}/{command}[/{namespace}] (EdgeContainerDeployer vectorRestFetch), on the app's Vectorize binding — not the Cloudflare REST API, whose global limit (1,200 req / 5 min per account, verified in the docs) would cap all customers at ~4 req/s. Queries go through dplyMetered (existing meter, cap, pause, price; no new meter or flag beyond resource-vectors). upsert / query (one or many) / fetch / delete / info with namespaces, dimension and id checks; upsert-data, query-data, filters, range, reset, update, sparse/hybrid, namespaces admin refused with 400. Per-index tokens (dvx_…) as one encrypted JSON map at meta.edge.vector_rest_tokens, registered in secret_vault json_crypt (APP_KEY rotation) and the SecretReencryptCoverageTest tripwire; Worker secret DPLY_VECTOR_TOKEN_{NAME}; UPSTASH_VECTOR_REST_URL/TOKEN for the first index; sheet "Over HTTPS" with URL, Show/Copy/Rotate. Tests: node test of the generated block with a fake binding (raw + real @upstash/vector when UPSTASH_SDK_DIR is set), token/rotation/secrets test; docs vector-search.md. Container apps only (SSR/hybrid bundles not covered).
title: Serverless data: Upstash-Vector-compatible REST over Vectorize; decide separate product vs inside dply
